newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian shares buoyant, Norma rises on earnings.
newsitem.headline: Estonian shares buoyant, Norma rises on earnings.

text.p: A buoyant Estonian stock market saw prices and the index increase and plastics maker Norma was in focus on the over-the-counter market, dealers said.
The Tallinn stock exchange index rose 1.91 per cent to 114.86 and the official list turned over 14.9 million kroons.

Shares in second-largest bank Savings Bank were most traded on volume of 4.4 million kroons. It rose further to 58.50 kroons from 57.50 kroons on Friday, benefiting from positive sentiment after its recent issue of shares was over-subscribed.
Market leader Hansapank turned over 3.8 million kroons and its closing price pushed up to 114 kroons from 109.25 kroons.
In Tallinna Pank, shares worth 3.7 million kroons changed hands and it also closed higher at 40.30 kroons versus 39.45.
On the over-the-counter free market, some 10.7 million kroons of shares were traded.
Business was led by plastics maker Norma which announced its 10-month profits and said it was optimistic for the year.
Norma turned over 3.75 million kroons and closed five kroons higher at 33.60 kroons.
The company said its 10-months sales were 333 million kroons and its profit 45.5 million kroons but it expected a 62 million kroon full-year profit, 14 million kroons more than its previous forecast.
